notes.title: Wetzlar Romanticism Museum and highest discount ever for Visual Novel Fest
notes.content:
Hello everyone, long time no see!

We hope you are all doing nicely. We've been working hard this last year, bouncing from idea to idea and trying to keep up with new projects. All secret still.

Regardless, we wanted to let you all know that Painting Werther is still at the Romanticism Museum in Wetzlar, Germany! 

Here we are, the actual house where Charlotte lived in the 18th Century and met Werther/Goethe.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39202209/4748798c8b28da4a5225bc09244f7c31f7cfcfe5.jpg[/img]
It has been an honor so far and we couldn't have been happier to work with them.

We hope you enjoy this Visual Novel Fest and we hope to see you guys soon!

Mad Cream Games

notes.title: A week of celebrations!
notes.content:
Firstly, starting now Painting Werther is [b]available in a new language[/b]. 
And it will be... [b]Turkish[/b]! 
Thank you so much to [i]İpek Keçeci[/i] for reaching out to us and making it a reality.

Next, Painting Werther will be travelling to Germany! 
For the 250th anniversary, our game will be part of the in [i]Werther Welten[/i], a temporal exposition in [b]Wetzlar's Romanticism Museum[/b]. 
This is the German town where the real world events transpired that inspired Goethe to write his novel! 
It will be from [b]September 2024 to January 2025[/b], so if you are able don't miss out on the opportunity!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39202209/65e5698ab88c95494acdd7712cf14a3df044a197.jpg[/img]
And finally, Pink Gum is celebrating it's [b]5th birthday[/b]! 
5 years from the release our first project, and we are still as excited with game dev as the first day we began! 
Let's all sing happy birthday to our little Pink game with a discount!!

We are still working on new projects and we are very thankful for your patience and support!
See you soon!

notes.content:

We have also put the biggest discount of our game in both our products!

Relive the game's sorrows and beauty with the music of the game!

There are also two extra songs in it for you guys to enjoy!!!

The soundtrack will include both .mp3 and .flac versions of the songs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39202209/ae307e64ac15a31b0253e70daedcc9950e34901b.png[/img]

Buying the OST here on steam will help us keep developing all the weird and crazy games we make, so we are very thankful for all of you in advance.

New games are coming, so stay tuned!

As a parting gift, we are also releasing a Mad Cream Games bundle, where you can buy all of our products, or just the ones you are still missing, so check it out!

notes.title: A more transparent roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

Maybe you already know but "Mad Cream Games" is just a family of three artist enjoying making games, nothing more; and PR unfortunately is not our forte.

Seeing that, we are aware that we haven't posted many development logs, because we prefer to focus on developing the game, rather than talking about it. Either way, we still feel that you deserve to know a little better of the work we are doing and in which state it is. That is why we are here to try to be a little more transparent about the development and future of Painting Werther:

First the good news... The game is almost complete.
More than 75% percent of all one hundred scenes are done and checked, with minor adjustment for the rest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39202209/3ee118739b85eac88d96ef33e3d5686d23dcaefd.jpg[/img]

The bad ones... We are still months away from release. 
We are remaking a lot of the early scenes and adding more substance to some of the late ones. 
We are also a little behind on the music part, but it should not be cause for concern, there are already 15 pieces and more on the way (5 of them already on our YouTube Channel). 
[previewyoutube=SPkN7EdRrDE;full][/previewyoutube]
The text of the demo and Steam page is being done by me, and there are probably a lot of mistakes (it will be greatly appreciated if you tell me about those hahaha). But don't worry, the final text for the game will be done by our cousin, a professional English translator (we are from Spain).
A very updated version of the demo is nearly out, we are just fighting with 4:3 displays for all of you who still use this cursed screen format hahaha (damn you cs pros...) (widescreen is already fixed internally thanks to Steam user Celo, who warned us about it).
Just so it doesn't surprise you, the demo will not transfer the saves to the final version because it does not represent the full start of the game (there are a LOT of scenes missing).

We are trying to make Painting Werther the best it can possibly be.
It is already more than two and a half hours long and, at least for us, it is kind of hypnotic.
We are working hard to be able to give it to you as soon as possible.
Thank you again for your patience and stay tuned for more upcoming announcements!
